text:
How to Play

  1. Choose a theme each, e.g. 'The Romans' or 'What I did Yesterday'.
  2. Write a paragraph relating to your theme which is all true except for one lie.
  3. Read each other's paragraphs and see if you can spot the lie. If you spot the other person’s lie, you get one point.
  4. Repeat two more times (so you have written three paragraphs each), choosing a new theme each time. The winner is the person with the most points at the end of the three rounds.

What if both players have the same number of points?

Read all the lies again and decide together which was the most creative and interesting. The player who wrote that lie wins!
In this game, you will be trying to sneak one lie past the other player.
